Players now have faces. Every list on the **Players** tab (online, whitelist, operators and bans) shows each player's head, with the hat layer, next to their name. Flytower fetches skins from Mojang itself and keeps them on disk under `/var/lib/flytower/skins`, so your browser never tells a third-party avatar site who plays on your server, a player's skin is checked again only once a day, and heads keep showing when Mojang is down. Offline-mode and unknown players get the default Steve or Alex head without anything being sent to Mojang.

Resetting a world can now end a season instead of throwing it away. The reset dialog offers to keep the old world as a **past world** under a name you choose, such as "2025–26 world", zipped with its datapacks so it opens in single player as it was, and to keep the final backup forever so retention never deletes it. Past worlds are listed on the **World** tab until you delete them, where each can be downloaded, shared with a link, renamed, or turned into a new server through **Import**. Any backup can also be marked **Keep forever** from its menu. See [Past worlds](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.2.0-beta.1/docs/backups.md#past-worlds).

Flytower can now wear your own brand. On **System → Branding**, set a name, an accent colour, a display font, a logo and a favicon, and the panel, the sign-in page, Discord notifications and in-game announcements all use them. Flytower works out lighter and darker shades from your colour and picks ones that pass WCAG AA contrast in both light and dark mode, so buttons and links stay readable. Uploaded SVGs are rebuilt without scripts or links to other files, and PNGs lose their metadata. A small "Powered by Flytower" line can be turned off. Nothing changes until you set something. See [Branding](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.2.0-beta.1/docs/branding.md).

Testing notes are in the "Player heads", "Past worlds" and "Branding" sections of [testing-1.2.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.2.0-beta.1/docs/testing-1.2.0.md).
